issue_and_fix.title: Instantiating a qt.QobjEvo with a qt.coefficient

issue_comment_findings.author: QuTiP maintainer
issue_comment_findings.summary: States that Coefficient can be used to build QobjEvo and that ignoring args is a bug; provides a workaround using QobjEvo.arguments().

issue_comment_findings.author: QuTiP maintainer
issue_comment_findings.summary: Explicitly identifies that coefficient() does not update args and provides a direct coefficient(existing, args=...) minimal example.

pr_review_findings.author: pmenczel
pr_review_findings.summary: Suggests asserting coeff2(0) == 2; the final regression test uses this expectation.

issue_and_fix.scope_caveat: Original issue body demonstrates QobjEvo construction but contains args={"g:2"}, a set literal rather than a mapping. The frozen selector and verified Stage 2 independent reproducer test direct coefficient(existing_coefficient, args={...}) behavior. Public issue comments connect that narrower path to the reported QobjEvo behavior. Preserve this prompt/selector scope discrepancy.

issue_family.finding: Existing Coefficient.replace_arguments support and QobjEvo coefficient construction form the related API family. No second independent issue/PR candidate was identified in the targeted search. This is not an exhaustive repository-wide historical issue audit.
issue_family.disposition: one candidate and one upstream sampling unit; no duplicate case added

exposure.note: Issue comments explicitly reveal the coefficient factory diagnosis; they are excluded from the frozen dataset problem_statement but counted in researcher exposure.

temporal_exposure.interpretation: Issue/PR-specific exposure is less likely by chronology; pre-existing QuTiP source exposure and exact training-data cutoff remain unresolved.
